body.name: \(\mathscr D_n\) and \(\Theta_{n,\alpha}\)
body.construction: For a candidate law \(Q\in\mathcal M\), let \(F_{x,Q}\), \(G_{x,Q}\), and \(p_{x,Q}\) denote its channels and stratum masses, and set \(\mathscr D_n(Q)=\sum_{x\in\mathcal X}\{\int_{\mathcal C_*}(|\widehat F_{x,n}-F_{x,Q}|^2+B_Y^{-2}|\widehat G_{x,n}-G_{x,Q}|^2)\,ds\,dt+|\widehat p_x-p_{x,Q}|^2\}\) and \(\Theta_{n,\alpha}=\{Q\in\mathcal M:\mathscr D_n(Q)\le\epsilon_n^2\}\).
